gap: No result ChatGPT got states that on 2026-11-17 only one of ChatGPT's three picks (EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3, $2,799) can be ordered from its maker with a full 30 A TT-30 outlet: the Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus is sold out on Anker's store and its TT-30 is capped at 25 A / 3,000 W, and BLUETTI's US store lists no AC500 unit, only its batteries and accessories. Three in-stock stations rated for the full 30 A / 3,600 W on the TT-30 cost $1,100 to $1,300 less: BLUETTI Apex 300 at $1,499, Growatt HELIOS 3600 at $1,599 and Anker SOLIX F3000 at $1,699.99.
standout_why: Compared against wattmatch.io (approximate prices, no dates, F3000 priced only as a ~$2,800 bundle, DELTA Pro 3 'sold out'), outagereadyhq.com (prices from 30 Oct 2026, a DELTA 3 Ultra flash sale since ended, no F3000, Apex 300 or HELIOS 3600) and rvpartsgiant.com (no prices; it notes the F3800 Plus is 'between shipments'). None prices the field on one date with stock status. None names the Growatt HELIOS 3600 or the in-stock $1,699.99 F3000 base unit. None says the BLUETTI AC500, ChatGPT's third pick, is missing from BLUETTI's US store. Rivals do have parts of this: the F3800 Plus 3,000 W TT-30 cap (rvpartsgiant, outagereadyhq) and an approximate Apex 300 price (wattmatch).
decides: The DELTA Pro 3 stays the pick for the biggest battery (4,096 Wh) and 4,000 W of headroom. For a shopper who mainly needs the full 30 A on the TT-30 and can buy today, the Apex 300 ($1,499, 3,840 W inverter, 2,764.8 Wh) or the F3000 ($1,699.99, 3,072 Wh) does the same TT-30 job for $1,100 to $1,300 less. The F3800 Plus and AC500 should drop out of the answer: neither can be bought from its maker, and the F3800 Plus's TT-30 tops out at 3,000 W. The EcoFlow DELTA 3 Ultra ($1,369, 3,600 W, 30 A port) is the cheapest full-30 A option but is a pre-order shipping in early December.
